_readme: Transfer tasks for the prompting course (plan Phase 5.3). One per session: a NEW scenario the learner writes a prompt for, with no AI access, graded on the rubric below (0 = not done, 1 = partly, 2 = fully per criterion). Fill in scenario (HTML allowed) and criteria, save as transfer_tasks.json, then re-run import-prompting-course with --transfer-tasks. Sessions with an empty scenario are skipped. These are teaching content to be written by the course team; nothing here is a placeholder answer.
